description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across 11 datasets (y-axis, ranging from 48 to 62) for three inference-based methods—Base, CORG, and AdaCAD (x-axis)—applied to two types of models: Standard instruction-tuned models (gray bars) and the proposed “Ours” models (blue bars), as described in the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” For the Base method, only the “Ours” model is shown, achieving approximately 59.2. For CORG, the “Standard” model scores around 51.3, while “Ours” reaches about 59.5. For AdaCAD, “Standard” achieves roughly 53.2, and “Ours” attains approximately 60.3. The “Ours” model consistently outperforms the “Standard” model in both CORG and AdaCAD, with the performance gap being particularly large in CORG. The bars are grouped by method, with “Standard” appearing first (gray) and “Ours” second (blue) within each group. The y-axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 2. No error bars or statistical annotations are visible. The chart visually emphasizes the performance gains of the proposed method across all applicable inference techniques.
